name: Jordan Schneider
summary: Jordan Schneider - ready-to-play pre-generated investigator (A&E doctor, Folly consultant).
notes: Imported from the Rivers of London rulebook, Appendix A: Ready-to-Play Investigators (printed p.343-349). Stat block reproduced for in-game use; backstory paraphrased. Unallocated pre-gen (scope []): a GM can assign it to a player to pick up and play.

sheet.name: Jordan Schneider
sheet.backstory: An A&E doctor who prefers the chaos of emergency medicine to general practice; a former rugby player with brains as well as brawn, drawn into Folly work after treating some 'curious' patients.
sheet.carry: Folly Consultant's Card, mobile phone and spare batteries, high-visibility jacket, and a doctor's bag (photo ID, prescription pad, safety alarm, alcohol wipes, PPE, alcohol gel, sharps bin, small torch, specimen bottles, syringes, dressings and surgical tape, stethoscope, blood pressure monitor, thermometer, paracetamol, ibuprofen, penicillin, adrenaline auto-injectors, and asthma inhalers, among other things).
